items.source: If your Cassandra table has multiple primary key columns, then you must define a primary key class, annotate it with this annotation, and use that class as the PrimaryKey of your entity class!
items.translation: 如果您的 Cassandra 表包含多个主键列，则必须定义一个主键类，使用此注解对其进行标注，并将该类用作实体类的PrimaryKey！

items.source: Alex Shvid, Matthew T. Adams, Mark Paluch
items.translation: 亚历克斯·什维德，马修·T·亚当斯，马克·帕卢奇

items.source: Annotates a type that represents the identity type of another class whose instances are stored in a table.
items.translation: 注解表示另一个类的身份类型的类型，该类的实例存储在表中。
